name: Black Dread Nation
description:
We are skilled, active fighters who never leave a man behind, We are looking for new recruits who are the best of the best. 

Our motto is: Never give up! never surrender! never fail! 

Our day of celebration is January 23. We mainly sword fight but we also do gun fighting. In Black Dread Nation we are not just a group, we are friends, we are family! We strive to be the best we can be and then better than that. Join today for a new experience!
